metadata.name: CSV Plotter (interaktiv)
metadata.description: The same chart as plotter.json, but the file is picked while the graph runs: one GUI node holds both the file picker and the plot, so the whole tool is a single window. Paths are relative to the working directory, so run this from the repository root.

nodes.label: Plotter
nodes.description: Pick a CSV at the top, see it charted below. A gui node's ports are derived from its widgets, so the picker's output and the plot's input are the node's own ports.

gui_widgets.value: Eine CSV-Datei wählen und ▶ Run drücken. Die erste Spalte ist die x-Achse, jede weitere wird als Reihe gezeichnet.

gui_widgets.label: Diagramm
gui_widgets.code_prompt: Generate Code to plot the graph, always plot an empty graph if no input is present. Have x and y axis and legends. Have a complete plot...

nodes.label: Zu Punkten
nodes.description: `read_file_inputs` turns the picked path into the file's text before this runs, so the node never touches the filesystem itself.

inputs.name: CSV
inputs.description: Resolved to the file's content before the node runs

config.code_prompt: Turn the CSV into a list of {label, value} points, largest first, scaled to millions.
